verification_report.summary:
The complete submitted proof is correct relative to the explicitly accepted prerequisites. Fourteen sequential checks and five reference checks found no critical errors or gaps. The book was read only; the separate section-degree audit was not required.

The restriction inclusion uses precisely the image ideal I(mu)O_Y: local coefficients of ambient weighted sections restrict into that ideal, and tensoring with the restricted line bundle preserves its inclusion in O_Y. No surjectivity of restriction or identification with I(m u|_Y) is assumed. Pullback preserves a nonzero section under a modification. Each pulled-back coefficient has divisorial order at least the minimum order of the image-ideal generators, so subtracting the stated finite sum of distinct divisors leaves an effective divisor.

With ddc=i partial bar-partial/(2 pi) and squared metric exp(-chi), beta=ddc chi represents c_1(L). Poincare–Lelong therefore has exactly the stated coefficient m, with no extra normalization factor. Current Stokes annihilates the logarithmic term against gamma^(r-1), and positivity of the remaining effective divisor gives the finite-degree inequality. The accepted full integer limits pass to any unbounded selected sequence and through the finite sum, preserving the direction degree >= sum of trace-weighted divisor volumes. No uniform convergence over metrics is needed.

The divisor Chern forms and pi^*(beta|_Y) are smooth, real and closed. Their Gauduchon pairings identify the numerical inequalities with nonnegative tests of the same form Theta against every Gauduchon metric. For r>=2, the accepted internal Lamari criterion supplies a genuine w with Theta+ddc w>=0. Its test formulation is also corroborated by [Tosatti, Lemma 2.1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1505.02124), after rescaling the potential for the different differential normalization. For r=1, M=integral_Z Theta is nonnegative and M eta-Theta has integral zero, so scalar Poisson gives the smooth representative M eta. The M=0 endpoint correctly yields the zero positive current. In both cases closedness follows from dTheta=0 and d ddc w=0, proving pseudoeffectivity in the displayed class.

A strict violation leaves a positive margin. Full integer convergence makes the finite order sum exceed the degree for every sufficiently large integer, contradicting the per-section inequality whenever V_m is nonzero. This proves eventual vanishing, without asserting an explicit numerical threshold.

The elliptic counterexample is valid. Unitary multipliers give a descended smooth flat metric; u=0 makes every image ideal the unit ideal and every trace number zero. A nonzero section of a positive tensor power would have an effective divisor of degree zero, hence no zeros. Its global logarithmic norm is then harmonic and constant, making its lifted holomorphic coefficient constant by maximum modulus. Irrationality ensures exp(2 pi i m a) is nontrivial for every positive m, forcing that constant to vanish. Thus all necessary conditions hold while every V_m is zero. The proof uses neither BMP nor higher-dimensional exact trace realization.
